content.short: Fragment is a decentralized auction platform for Telegram usernames and virtual phone numbers, powered by TON.
content.description: Fragment is a unique, decentralized auction platform designed to facilitate the secure and transparent sale of premium Telegram usernames and anonymous virtual phone numbers (+888). Built on the TON blockchain, Fragment ensures that ownership of these digital assets is permanently recorded and easily transferable. All transactions on the platform are settled in Toncoin, making it a groundbreaking example of how blockchain technology can be integrated with social platforms to provide true digital ownership for users across the globe.
content.meta: Own your Telegram identity with Fragment. Auction usernames and virtual numbers on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
